g.text: CLUSTERING: streaming_decomposition.py L2-normalises the feature vector before spherical k-means, and magnitude is exactly the part that

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: encodes 'how much this matters'. What survives is direction — which weights fire together. The decomposition is co-attribution by construction.
